 312 | def filter_settings_spec(settings_spec, *exclude, **replace):
 313 |     """Return a copy of `settings_spec` excluding/replacing some settings.
 314 | 
 315 |     `settings_spec` is a tuple of configuration settings
 316 |     (cf. `docutils.SettingsSpec.settings_spec`).
 317 | 
 318 |     Optional positional arguments are names of to-be-excluded settings.
 319 |     Keyword arguments are option specification replacements.
 320 |     (See the html4strict writer for an example.)
 321 |     """
 322 |     settings = list(settings_spec)
 323 |     # every third item is a sequence of option tuples
 324 |     for i in range(2, len(settings), 3):
 325 |         newopts = []
 326 |         for opt_spec in settings[i]:
 327 |             # opt_spec is ("<help>", [<option strings>], {<keyword args>})
 328 |             opt_name = [opt_string[2:].replace('-', '_')
 329 |                         for opt_string in opt_spec[1]
 330 |                         if opt_string.startswith('--')][0]
 331 |             if opt_name in exclude:
 332 |                 continue
 333 |             if opt_name in replace.keys():
 334 |                 newopts.append(replace[opt_name])
 335 |             else:
 336 |                 newopts.append(opt_spec)
 337 |         settings[i] = tuple(newopts)
 338 |     return tuple(settings)
